about: The inventory's art direction in motion: ROUTE AND ECHO. Scripted input for a capture, not hands-on.

steps.say: EQUIPMENT, ROUTE AND ECHO -- THE ROUTE RUNS FROM THE KEY, THROUGH WHAT IS ON IT, TO THE NAME

steps.mark: at rest: RMB, what is on it, and its two echoes (MK II)

steps.say: RIGHT, THEN DOWN ONE AT A TIME -- THE ROUTE GLIDES, THE ECHOES STEP OUT; THE WORDS ARE WHOLE AT ONCE

steps.mark: 0.1 s after a press: the words already whole, the route still gliding
one at a time: HUNTER'S DRAW against what is on RMB

steps.say: SEVEN RAPID DOWNS -- NO WORD SQUASHES, NOTHING OVERLAPS; THE ROUTE CATCHES UP

steps.mark: landed: SILVER VOLLEY, MK III -- three echoes

steps.say: SILVER VOLLEY IS MK III: THREE ITEMS WENT INTO IT, SO THREE ECHOES STAND BEHIND ITS NAME
UP -- THE LONGEST NAME, WITH A LONG DESCRIPTION: THE PLATE WRAPS; NOTHING IS CUT OR SHRUNK

steps.mark: the longest name, with a long description

steps.say: ENTER -- A LOCAL PREVIEW ON RMB, NOT SENT: THE KEY NOW CARRIES IT
LEFT, DOWN x4 -- ANOTHER KEY: THE ROUTE RE-RUNS FROM Q

steps.mark: another key: Q, and what is on it
